items.title: CVE-2026-137668: Basic Cross Site Scripting in ONNX ONNXMLTools
items.summary: A basic cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in ONNX ONNXMLTools versions 1.0 through 1.16.0 in the visualizemodel function of onnxmltools/utils/visualize.py. The flaw is caused by improper handling of the producername argument, allowing remote attackers to inject malicious scripts. Exploit code has been published, but a fix is pending acceptance

items.title: CVE-2026-137667: Cross Site Scripting in ONNX ONNXMLTools
items.summary: CVE-2026-137667 is a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in ONNX ONNXMLTools up to version 1.16.0. It affects the getsetnode function in the Model Visualization component (onnxmltools/utils/visualize.py). The vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute XSS attacks. Public exploit code is available, and a fix is pending acceptance in a pull request.
